1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * boards/espressif/esp32p4/esp32p4-function-ev-board/src/esp32p4_display.c
3:  *
4:  * Simple Boot display bring-up for the 7" 1024x600 MIPI-DSI panel
5:  * (EK79007-class driver IC on the LCD adapter board).
6:  *
7:  * Sequence: power DPHY LDO -> DSI host init (2 lanes @1Gbps) -> panel
8:  * hard reset (GPIO27) -> vendor init cmds over LP DCS -> DPI timing ->
9:  * framebuffer (PSRAM) bind -> video start -> backlight (GPIO26).
10:  ****************************************************************************/
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/config.h>
13: 
14: #include <stdio.h>
15: #include <stdlib.h>
16: #include <string.h>
17: 
18: #include <nuttx/video/mipi_dsi.h>
19: #include <nuttx/video/fb.h>
20: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
21: #include <nuttx/kmalloc.h>
22: 
23: #include "esp_mipi_dsi.h"
24: #include "esp_ldo.h"
25: #include "esp_gpio.h"
26: 
27: #define LCD_RST_GPIO       27
28: #define LCD_BL_GPIO        26
29: 
30: #define FB_W               1024
31: #define FB_H               600
32: #define FB_BPP             16
33: #define FB_SIZE            (FB_W * FB_H * FB_BPP / 8)
34: 
35: static FAR uint16_t *g_fb;
36: static volatile bool g_ready;
37: 
38: /* EK79007 vendor registers */
39: #define EK79007_PAD_CONTROL 0xB2
40: #define EK79007_DSI_2_LANE  0x10
41: #define EK79007_CMD_SLPOUT  0x11
42: 
43: static const uint8_t g_ek79007_init[][2] =
44: {
45:     {0x80, 0x8B}, {0x81, 0x78}, {0x82, 0x84}, {0x83, 0x88},
46:     {0x84, 0xA8}, {0x85, 0xE3}, {0x86, 0x88},
47: };
48: 
49: /****************************************************************************
50:  * Name: esp32p4_display_init
51:  ****************************************************************************/
52: 
53: int esp32p4_display_init(void)
54: {
55:   if (g_ready)
56:     {
57:       return OK;
58:     }
59: 
60:   struct esp_ldo_config_t phy_ldo;
61:   struct esp_mipi_dsi_dpi_config_s dpi;
62:   struct mipi_dsi_device *dev;
63:   FAR uint16_t *fb;
64:   unsigned int i;
65:   int ret;
66: 
67:   /* 1. VDD_MIPI_DPHY from on-chip LDO channel 3 @ 2.5V */
68: 
69:   phy_ldo.chan_id    = 3;
70:   phy_ldo.voltage_mv = 2500;
71:   phy_ldo.handler    = NULL;
72: 
73:   ret = esp_ldo_channel_acquire(&phy_ldo);
74:   printf("DISP: dphy ldo ch3@2.5V -> %d\n", ret);
75:   if (ret != OK)
76:     {
77:       return ret;
78:     }
79: 
80:   /* 2. DSI host: 2 data lanes @ 1000 Mbps (Kconfig defaults) */
81: 
82:   ret = esp_mipi_dsi_initialize(NULL);
83:   printf("DISP: dsi host init -> %d\n", ret);
84:   if (ret != OK)
85:     {
86:       return ret;
87:     }
88: 
89:   dev = mipi_dsi_device_register(esp_mipi_dsi_host_get(), "ek79007", 0);
90:   if (dev == NULL)
91:     {
92:       printf("DISP: device register failed\n");
93:       return -ENODEV;
94:     }
95: 
96:   dev->lanes     = 2;
97:   dev->format    = MIPI_DSI_FMT_RGB565;
98:   dev->mode_flags = MIPI_DSI_MODE_VIDEO | MIPI_DSI_MODE_LPM;
99: 
100:   /* 3. Panel hardware reset, active low */
101: 
102:   esp_configgpio(LCD_RST_GPIO, OUTPUT);
103:   esp_gpiowrite(LCD_RST_GPIO, false);
104:   nxsig_usleep(10 * 1000);
105:   esp_gpiowrite(LCD_RST_GPIO, true);
106:   nxsig_usleep(20 * 1000);
107: 
108:   /* 4. Vendor init sequence over LP DCS */
109: 
110:   uint8_t lane_cmd = EK79007_DSI_2_LANE;
111:   mipi_dsi_dcs_write(dev, EK79007_PAD_CONTROL, &lane_cmd, 1);
112: 
113:   for (i = 0; i < sizeof(g_ek79007_init) / sizeof(g_ek79007_init[0]); i++)
114:     {
115:       mipi_dsi_dcs_write(dev, g_ek79007_init[i][0], &g_ek79007_init[i][1], 1);
116:     }
117: 
118:   mipi_dsi_dcs_write(dev, EK79007_CMD_SLPOUT, NULL, 0);
119:   nxsig_usleep(120 * 1000);
120:   printf("DISP: panel init done\n");
121: 
122:   /* 5. DPI timing: 1024x600 @ ~60Hz, pixel clock ~48 MHz */
123: 
124:   memset(&dpi, 0, sizeof(dpi));
125:   dpi.h_res              = FB_W;
126:   dpi.v_res              = FB_H;
127:   dpi.hsync_pulse_width  = 10;
128:   dpi.hsync_back_porch   = 120;
129:   dpi.hsync_front_porch  = 120;
130:   dpi.vsync_pulse_width  = 1;
131:   dpi.vsync_back_porch   = 20;
132:   dpi.vsync_front_porch  = 10;
133:   dpi.dpi_clock_freq_mhz = 48;
134:   dpi.virtual_channel    = 0;
135:   dpi.format             = MIPI_DSI_FMT_RGB565;
136: 
137:   ret = esp_mipi_dsi_configure_dpi(&dpi);
138:   printf("DISP: dpi config -> %d\n", ret);
139:   if (ret != OK)
140:     {
141:       return ret;
142:     }
143: 
144:   /* 6. Framebuffer from PSRAM-backed heap */
145: 
146:   fb = kmm_malloc(FB_SIZE);
147:   if (fb == NULL)
148:     {
149:       /* Heap fallback: carve straight from the mapped PSRAM window.
150:        * The kernel heap currently does not hand out PSRAM, so the
151:        * beginning of the window is guaranteed untouched. */
152:       extern uintptr_t esp_psram_extram_vaddr_start(void);
153:       uintptr_t p = esp_psram_extram_vaddr_start();
154:       printf("DISP: heap short, carve fb @%08lx\n", (unsigned long)p);
155:       fb = (FAR uint16_t *)p;
156:     }
157: 
158:   for (i = 0; i < FB_W * FB_H; i++)
159:     {
160:       uint16_t x = i % FB_W;
161:       uint16_t y = i / FB_W;
162:       uint16_t r = (x * 31 / FB_W) << 11;
163:       uint16_t g = (y * 63 / FB_H) << 5;
164:       uint16_t b = ((x + y) * 31 / (FB_W + FB_H));
165:       fb[i] = r | g | b;
166:     }
167: 
168:   ret = esp_mipi_dsi_bind_framebuffer(fb, FB_SIZE, FB_W, FB_H, FB_BPP);
169:   printf("DISP: fb bind -> %d\n", ret);
170:   if (ret != OK)
171:     {
172:       kmm_free(fb);
173:       return ret;
174:     }
175: 
176:   esp_mipi_dsi_flush_framebuffer(fb, FB_SIZE);
177: 
178:   /* 7. Go live, then backlight on */
179: 
180:   ret = esp_mipi_dsi_video_start();
181:   printf("DISP: video start -> %d\n", ret);
182:   if (ret != OK)
183:     {
184:       return ret;
185:     }
186: 
187:   g_fb     = fb;
188:   g_ready  = true;
189: 
190:   ret = fb_register(0, 0);
191:   printf("DISP: /dev/fb0 register -> %d\n", ret);
192: 
193:   esp_configgpio(LCD_BL_GPIO, OUTPUT);
194:   esp_gpiowrite(LCD_BL_GPIO, true);
195:   printf("DISP: backlight on\n");
196: 
197:   return OK;
198: }
199: 
200: 
201: /****************************************************************************
202:  * Framebuffer character device glue (/dev/fb0) for LVGL & apps.
203:  * The pixel surface is the PSRAM buffer already bound to DW-GDMA.
204:  ****************************************************************************/
205: 
206: static int disp_getvideoinfo(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
207:                              FAR struct fb_videoinfo_s *vinfo)
208: {
209:   vinfo->fmt     = FB_FMT_RGB16_565;
210:   vinfo->xres    = FB_W;
211:   vinfo->yres    = FB_H;
212:   vinfo->nplanes = 1;
213:   return OK;
214: }
215: 
216: static int disp_getplaneinfo(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int planeno,
217:                              FAR struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo)
218: {
219:   if (planeno != 0)
220:     {
221:       return -EINVAL;
222:     }
223: 
224:   pinfo->fbmem   = (FAR void *)g_fb;
225:   pinfo->fblen   = FB_SIZE;
226:   pinfo->stride   = FB_W * 2;
227:   pinfo->display  = 0;
228:   pinfo->bpp      = FB_BPP;
229:   return OK;
230: }
231: 
232: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_UPDATE
233: static int disp_updatearea(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
234:                            FAR const struct fb_area_s *area)
235: {
236:   esp_mipi_dsi_flush_framebuffer(g_fb, FB_SIZE);
237:   return OK;
238: }
239: #endif
240: 
241: static struct fb_vtable_s g_disp_vtable =
242: {
243:   .getvideoinfo = disp_getvideoinfo,
244:   .getplaneinfo = disp_getplaneinfo,
245: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_UPDATE
246:   .updatearea   = disp_updatearea,
247: #endif
248: };
249: 
250: /* Arch hooks used by fb_register() when CONFIG_VIDEO_FB is enabled */
251: 
252: int up_fbinitialize(int display)
253: {
254:   return esp32p4_display_init();
255: }
256: 
257: FAR struct fb_vtable_s *up_fbgetvplane(int display, int plane)
258: {
259:   return g_ready ? &g_disp_vtable : NULL;
260: }
